finishedText:
Visit date: 12/11. Present: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes, Bea. 

During the visit, it was observed that mould in the back bedroom has returned and is worse by the window. She stated that the landlord has not replied to two emails. A letter was noted on the table. It was identified that Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline last week, and this letter was also on the table. The date of birth on the form is 3/3/87.

The following actions were agreed upon. The worker will ring the landlord on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes agreed to post the form on Friday. It was noted that Tomas Brandvold, a neighbour who is also on the worker list, offered to help her with the form.

The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late. The next step is to revisit on 26/11.
